newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Airwork NZ completes Transtar acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Airwork NZ completes Transtar acquisition.

text.p: Aviation operations and maintenance company Airwork (NZ) Ltd on Tuesday said it had completed the joint acquisition, with Seattle-based Helipro Corporation, of Transtar Aviation Services.
Transtar is a helicopter maintenance firm based in Texas.
Airwork managing director Hugh Jones said Transtar would provide Airwork with the approvals necessary to expand further its operations in Asia.
Transtar is a U.S. Federal Aviation Authority (FAA)-approved operator and Bell Helicopter Service Centre.
Jones said he expected Airwork and Helipro to develop Transtar as a base for growth in the rapidly expanding Latin American helicopter market.
Airwork had set itself growth targets based on strong growth in the airfreight and aircraft maintenance industries.
Listed New Zealand investor Direct Capital Partners, which specialises in investing in unlisted companies, in January took a 44.5 percent stake in Airwork NZ for NZ$12 million.
